title: Hello, Linux
story: Welcome to the Cyberus Linux Quest lab! Before you start hunting for bugs and vulnerabilities, let's learn how to submit a flag.
objective:
Run the following command in your terminal to submit your warm-up flag:
  quest submit CYBERUS{hello_linux}
hints: Copy or type the exact command shown in the objective: quest submit CYBERUS{hello_linux}
Flags always use the format CYBERUS{...}.
